corpusPurpose: Approved CAM product-contract generated-answer evaluation v2. Same cases as v1; latency contract splits warm retrieval p95 from warm generation p95. Contains no personal vault data, donor source, credentials, or web content.

passages.text: CAM Assistant is one quiet native front door to local knowledge, projects, research, Mac care, and specialized tools.
The application remains useful without CAM, network access, cloud credentials, or optional modules.
Raw vault material and secrets remain local unless an exact outbound policy produces an approved scrubbed payload.
A request without a route suffix stays local, and an unavailable explicit route fails without provider substitution.
A repository idea card is a candidate, not permission to copy code, alter a repository, or promote an unverified claim into product truth.
Answers remain ephemeral until the user explicitly keeps or promotes them.
Local model selection is explicit, versioned, and health checked before use.
